narrow: piRNA-mediated retrotransposon silencing by heterochromatin formation

definition: A transposable element silencing mechanism in which a Piwi-associated RNA (piRNA) triggers heterochromatin assembly. Heterochromatin is a chromatin conformation that is refractory to transcription.
label: Regulation of endogenous retroelements by Piwi-interacting RNAs (piRNAs)
